title: Linux supervision and linger
text: The systemd user relay stops after the last logout. Linger is refused as relay_linger_enabled; disable it with loginctl disable-linger, then retry yoke relay install. On WSL the systemd user manager comes from the distro's session-1 login; when it ends, relay install refuses relay_systemd_user_manager_unavailable and names wsl.exe --terminate <distro> from Windows as the recovery, never linger.
